title: Seoul

pages.message: Though small particles typically remain in the atmosphere for only a few days, they can be transported far away from source regions by large scale weather systems.

note: Ours: the city picked by how often its PM2.5 swings between its own cleanest-10 % and dirtiest-10 % days in 2025 (Seoul by choice); one hour a day (00:30 UTC); each swing marked smog (into the high band) or clear (into the low band).

sources.license: NASA data, no restrictions on use
sources.credit: Keller, C. A., et al. (2021). Description of the NASA GEOS composition forecast modeling system GEOS-CF v1.0. JAMES 13, e2020MS002413.
sources.substitute: EIC 5151 links GEOS-CF v2, which starts on 2025-08-04 and holds no whole calendar year; v1 holds all of 2025 (user, 2026-11-15).

units.swing: smog: the day the air crosses into the city's high band (p90); clear: into its low band (p10)
